question: Kolkata metro rail was opened for commercial services in ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1984**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Kolkata Metro opened for commercial services on October 24, 1984: 
 
• The Construction began in 1972 
 
• The first stretch of the metro was between Bhawanipore (now Netaji Bhawan) and Esplanade 
 
• The first stretch was about 3.4 km long 
 
• The Kolkata Metro was India's first operational rapid transit system 
 
• As of 2020, the Kolkata Metro has two operational lines:
 
• Noapara to Kavi Subhash: This line is 27.22 km long
 
• Salt Lake Sector V to Phoolbagah: This line is 7.205 km lon
